summary_md: **HiMorishige ([@_himorishige](https://x.com/_himorishige/status/2116328675356586237))** notes NVIDIA's **NVFP4 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017**, which shrinks the model from about 475 GiB to 400 GiB with GPQA Diamond going from 92.77% to 92.93%. Even four DGX Sparks would be tight once cache is counted ([nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-NVFP4)).
relevance: Sizing a frontier MoE for DGX Spark.
